ATI Inc. customer concentration single-source risk supplier diversify 10-K

findings.claim: ATI FY2025 10-K 揭露：任何年度皆無單一客戶占銷售超過 10%，核心終端市場為航太國防、特殊能源、電子、醫療。
findings.excerpt: No single customer accounted for more than 10% of sales for any year presented. The core end markets for ATI's products are customers in the aerospace & defense, specialty energy, electronics, and medical markets.

findings.claim: ATI 與 Airbus 簽多年期鈦板／片／billet 合約（2025 年 5 月）；Boeing 鈦協議延長且非排他。搜尋結果未找到任一客戶導入第二供應商或將鈦材自製（in-house）的來源。
findings.source: ATI IR press release: ATI signs multi-year agreement with Airbus for titanium plate, sheet and billet

customer_second_source.note: 只做 2 次搜尋；未查到客戶 in-house 或第二供應商的證據（none 性質）；Airbus 日期為約略月份，未逐字驗證；Boeing 非排他為搜尋摘要轉述，無逐字原文。
